meta.title: Healing data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60): Priest Holy and Discipline, Druid Restoration, Shaman Restoration, Paladin Holy
meta.scope: Every healing spell the five healing specs use in the practice yard, with cost, cast time, cooldown, base healing, variance and healing power coefficient from the Forever beta client rows; the healing rules the yard applies (crit, overhealing, heals over time, shields, the five-second rule); the talents each spec models with their values; the builds; the priority lists (the yellow glow and the cue); the party and the incoming damage model; default stats; and what is uncertain. Damage, tanking and the DPS hybrids are in the class sheets.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is the client table, a Wowhead Forever tooltip URL, a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path) or 'ours'. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by the Forever beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70450, read through wago.tools) or a Wowhead Forever tooltip read on 25 Oct 2026, or both.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of ours or of a sim with no Forever source yet, or a value where the sources disagree. Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the Classic 1.12 rule is kept.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit bb5811b3af (24 Oct 2026). Its talent trees (ui/core/talents/trees) are the layout the yard draws. Its priest healing spec (sim/priest/healing) is the wowsims/classic stub: the heals are commented-out WotLK numbers, and its Disc and Holy test strings predate the Oct 15 trees. No healer APL.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 10205cb9bc (22 Oct 2026). Registers healer specs for priest (sim/priest/healer), druid (sim/druid/restoration), paladin (sim/paladin/holy) and shaman (sim/shaman/restoration) on the client rows: priest heals, Power Word: Shield with Weakened Soul, Renewed Hope, Divine Aegis, Litany of Light, Inspiration, Prayer of Mending jumps, Holy Light, Flash of Light, Holy Shock, Divine Favor, Illumination, Infusion of Light, Light's Vigil, Water Shield, Mana Tide and Nature's Swiftness are modelled; the druid healing talents, Riptide and the shaman heals (sim/shaman/_heals.go, WotLK numbers) are TODO or disabled. No healer APL; its test talent strings are on older tree shapes (only the Disc preset decodes on the current trees).

practiceYardSummary: Heals never miss and crit for 1.5x; the crit chance is the spell crit on the sheet plus the healing talents. Ticks of heals over time re-read healing power and can crit (the sims roll heal crits on ticks; provisional).
Healing power is the one spell power number Forever gear carries, plus Spiritual Guidance (priest). What the target was not missing is overhealing; a shield counts in full.

The dummy hurts your party: a tank in melee (6,500 health), a rogue, a mage and a hunter (3,800 each) and you. Blows on the tank every 2.5 s for 600 (after armor): steady, spiky (15% crits x2, 20% crushing x1.5) or raid-style (softer blows, splashes, a blast on everyone every 15 s). One healer sustains about 200 healing per second over minutes before the mana runs out.

No healing meter: the panel counts heals and crits per spell, overhealing, heals on a full target, the time the tank spent under 40%, deaths, Spirit regeneration time and the time without mana for your main heal.

Season of Discovery rows sit in the client (Lifebloom, Nourish, Circle of Healing, Pain Suppression, Earth Shield, Sacred Shield, Beacon of Light): Wowhead prints them at "Requires level 1" with rune-style scaling and no trainer rank, so the yard leaves them out.

blow.note: Sized so that one healer sustains it for a couple of minutes before the mana runs out (about 200 healing per second sustained): raise it for a sprint, lower it to learn the rhythm.

death.unit: s until a dead party member is back on their feet (counted as a death)

targeting.value: heals land on your target if it is a party member, else on you; F1 targets you, F2 to F5 the party; click a party member or their dummy

hints.note: No sim publishes a healer priority list. These are ours; the yellow glow names the spell and the cue above the bar names the target. "Low" is the party member missing the largest share of their health.
priestHoly: Prayer of Mending on the tank when it is free and not on anyone.
Three or more under 80%: Inner Focus then Prayer of Healing.
Low under 75%: Binding Heal when you are hurt too, else Flash Heal.
Nobody missing more than 8%: nothing (do not overheal).
priestDisc: Power Word: Shield on the tank whenever they can be shielded.
Low under 35%: Penance, else Flash Heal.
Prayer of Mending, Prayer of Healing as Holy.
Tank under 70%: Penance, else Greater Heal.
Renew on the tank, Flash Heal on the low member, as Holy.
druidResto: Low under 35%: Swiftmend if they carry your heal over time, else Nature's Swiftness and Healing Touch, else Regrowth.
Three or more under 80%: Wild Growth.
Tank under 70%: Regrowth if it is not ticking, else Healing Touch.
Low under 75%: Rejuvenation if missing, else Regrowth.
shamanResto: Water Shield when it is down.
Mana Tide under 50% mana, potion under 30%.
Low under 35%: Nature's Swiftness and Healing Wave, else Lesser Healing Wave.
Riptide on the tank when it is ready and not ticking.
Three or more under 80%: Chain Heal (on the Riptide target if they are hurt).
Low under 75%: Riptide, else Lesser Healing Wave.
Nobody hurt and no Water totem: Healing Stream Totem.
paladinHoly: Blessing of Light on the tank.
Low under 35%: Holy Shock, else Flash of Light.
Holy Shock on cooldown on the low member under 85% (on a Light's Vigil tank first).
Tank under 75%: Light's Vigil under 65%, Divine Favor under 50%, Holy Light when Infusion of Light is up, the tank is under 60% or missing more than 1,800.

engineNotes.targeting: Ability.target 'friend': lands on your target when it is a party member, else on you; no facing; 40 yd. The tank is allies[0].
engineNotes.heal: Combat.heal(): healing taken multipliers, effective = min(amount, missing) unless a shield, per-spell rows (hits, crits, total effective, overheal), counters healing/overheal/shielding/heals/healsOnFull, a heal event, afterHeal hooks (Illumination, Water Shield, Divine Aegis).
engineNotes.damageAlly: Absorb auras soak first, then health; onDamageTaken hooks (Prayer of Mending, Water Shield); a member at 0 health is dead for 6 s.
engineNotes.partyBlow: Scheduled every `speed` s while partyDamage.on; profiles as in party.profiles; raid-style adds a blast on everyone every 15 s.
engineNotes.review: healingReview(): overhealing %, heals on a full target, tank under 40% time, deaths, shields soaked, Spirit regeneration time, mana from Judgement of Wisdom, time without mana for the main heal.
